configuration: the upstream ctest entry pytest::basic_tests_py3.14: run the shipped pytest suite unchanged in a scratch copy of the staged tree, with one change to its data: the staged reference file test/pytest/test_nrntest_thread.json is replaced by an empty json object, so the suite's Chk helper records every simulation value it would otherwise compare; run.sh then flattens the saved json (keys sorted, numeric leaves only) into chk_values.txt
observable: every numeric simulation value the suite records through its Chk helper, flattened from the saved json in sorted key order, one value per line in chk_values.txt
variant: identical to nominal, with reason: every test in the suite constructs its own fixed model and inputs, so no external initial condition reaches any of them; an identical copy is the only sensible variant and the tolerance is exercised by the altbuild floor
altbuild: an -O0 build of the same source: run.sh altbuild appends -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-O0 and -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-O0 to the same cmake flags and builds into its own cache entry; selfcheck runs the nominal inputs on it and measures this check's floor from the disagreement between the two builds

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck on 2026-09-16: run.sh altbuild (same source rebuilt with optimization off: -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-O0 and -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-O0 appended to the same cmake flags) against run.sh nominal, graded with the check's own validate.py: bit-identical output

altbuild.what: same source rebuilt with optimization off: -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-O0 and -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-O0 appended to the same cmake flags

warrant: Upstream grades this suite by its pytest exit status, but its Chk-based test exists to compare simulation values against a committed reference file; blanking the staged copy makes the suite emit those same values, which this check grades pointwise while every other test's assertions still gate the exit status. The band is achievable because every recorded value comes from a fixed deterministic model; repeats on one build agree bit for bit (these are the same values upstream stores as a committed reference) and the -O0 altbuild moves them only at the measured floor. It is discriminating because a real fault in the exercised simulation paths changes the recorded values far outside the band; upstream grades these same values against its committed reference. The floor is measured against the declared -O0 altbuild at selfcheck.
